lines.zh: 八条腿踩在枯叶上，响成一片。
lines.en: Eight legs on dead leaves make a dry clatter.

lines.zh: 我的骨架很轻，走起来没有重量。
lines.en: My frame is light; I walk without weight.

lines.zh: 我沿着树干往上，一节一节。
lines.en: I climb the trunk one segment at a time.

lines.zh: 白色骨节在暗处也看得见。
lines.en: My white joints show even in the dark.
I sidle along the graveyard's edge.
The shards on my back click softly.

lines.zh: 我踩过蛛网，网是我自己结的。
lines.en: I cross my own web without tearing it.

lines.zh: 腿太多了，拐弯时容易乱。
lines.en: With this many legs, corners get messy.

lines.zh: 我贴着雾走，尽量不出声。
lines.en: I move along the fog, trying to stay quiet.

lines.zh: 前面有光，我往阴影里退。
lines.en: Light ahead; I slip back into shadow.

lines.zh: 倒挂在枝上，我一点点挪。
lines.en: Hanging upside down, I inch along the branch.
Bone grinds on bone, a little rough.
I skirt that abandoned well.

lines.zh: 雾里的路，我记得很清楚。
lines.en: I know the paths in this fog quite well.

lines.zh: 我踩着自己的蛛丝荡过去。
lines.en: I swing across on a strand of my own silk.

lines.zh: 我从墓碑上爬下来，骨头轻响。
lines.en: I climb down the headstone with a dry click.
I hang from the beam without moving.

lines.zh: 眼睛太多了，闭上也睡不着。
lines.en: Too many eyes; even shut, I can't sleep.
I'm cleaning my front legs.

lines.zh: 骨头不需要吃，但我还是会饿。
lines.en: Bone doesn't need food, yet I still hunger.

lines.zh: 风穿过我的肋骨，有回声。
lines.en: Wind passes through my ribs and echoes.
I count the sounds inside the fog.

lines.zh: 蛛丝挂在角上，我懒得理。
lines.en: Web strands hang off my horns; I ignore them.

lines.zh: 骨头里在响，像有人在敲。
lines.en: Something knocks inside my bones.
I slowly draw my legs in.
The moon here is always very white.

lines.zh: 网上有东西在挣，我还没动。
lines.en: Something struggles in my web; I haven't moved.
One of my shards trembles slightly.
All eight of my eyes look at you.
You stepped on my web.

lines.zh: 八只眼睛干得发涩，也闭不上。
lines.en: Eight dry eyes sting, and none of them close.

lines.zh: 火把举低些，我的眼睛受不了。
lines.en: Lower that torch; my eyes can't take it.
I'm judging how long you'd last.
Hold still; I'm counting your heartbeats.

lines.zh: 你身后有座坟，你知道吗？
lines.en: There's a grave behind you, did you know?
I lower my head and only look.
A face of bone can't smile.
Walk slower and let me see you clearly.
A leg is broken; I can still run.
Hitting bone makes an ugly sound.
One of my shards has shattered.
My armor caught most of it.
I retreat, legs slightly tangled.
Something oozes between my joints.

lines.zh: 别瞄准眼睛，那儿没骨头。
lines.en: Don't aim for my eyes; there's no bone there.
The pain makes me draw all my legs in.
This frame is more brittle than I thought.
I hadn't finished that web.

lines.zh: 你手里那块肉，味道很重。
lines.en: That meat in your hand smells strong.

lines.zh: 骨头？你从哪儿弄来的骨头？
lines.en: Bones? Where did you get bones?

lines.zh: 我往前挪了一步，腿自己动的。
lines.en: I take a step forward; my legs moved on their own.

lines.zh: 那块肉还在滴，我闻得到。
lines.en: It's still dripping; I can smell it.

lines.zh: 放在地上退开，我才肯下来。
lines.en: Put it down and step back, then I'll come down.

lines.zh: 我很少对活物这么感兴趣。
lines.en: I'm rarely this interested in the living.
Don't wave it; my eyes blur.
I can wait; waiting is my specialty.

lines.zh: 这味道让我想起死掉的东西。
lines.en: This smell reminds me of things that died.

lines.zh: 再挪半步，我的前肢就碰到。
lines.en: Half a step more and my front legs reach it.
My legs tangled with yours, sorry.
Bone hits bone with a loud crack.
I'm much harder than I look.

lines.zh: 你撞在我背上，像撞上栅栏。
lines.en: You hit my back like hitting a fence.
I back off, all eight legs in a muddle.

lines.zh: 脚下留情，我的腿是空心的。
lines.en: Watch your feet; my legs are hollow bone.
We're wedged in the doorway.

lines.zh: 我侧身让你过，骨片刮到你。
lines.en: I turn to let you by and a shard scrapes you.

lines.zh: 我的护甲很厚，你不用道歉。
lines.en: My armor is thick; no need to apologize.

lines.zh: 撞完我抖了抖，落下一层灰。
lines.en: After the bump I shake off a layer of dust.
Her frame is a size smaller than mine.

lines.zh: 我们用前肢互相敲了敲。
lines.en: We tap each other with our front legs.

lines.zh: 八只眼睛对着八只眼睛。
lines.en: Eight eyes meet eight eyes.
I push a shard toward her.
She takes it without a word.
We spin the same web.
In the fog there are only the two of us.
Her legs are whiter than mine.
We hang side by side and wait for dawn.

lines.zh: 骨头不会老，我们可以慢慢来。
lines.en: Bone doesn't age; we can take our time.

lines.zh: 我用前肢夹起那块骨片。
lines.en: I lift that shard with my front legs.
String wraps my leg; I tug at it.
This eye, I'll keep it safe.
I hang it on the web to dry.
Too heavy; I drag it behind me.
Something dropped; I pick it up.

lines.zh: 我嘴里塞着东西，说不了话。
lines.en: With my mouth full I can't speak.

lines.zh: 这堆骨头里有一根是新的。
lines.en: One bone in this pile is new.
I wrap it twice in silk.
Don't touch; that's my collection.

lines.zh: 那个在雾里走的人，我选中了。
lines.en: The one walking in the fog, I've chosen him.
First I nudge a shard up to my legs.
This one is slower than the last.

lines.zh: 我从上面看它，它没抬头。
lines.en: I watch from above; it doesn't look up.
Once I choose, I don't switch.

lines.zh: 它踩断枯枝，我听见了位置。
lines.en: It snapped a dead twig; now I know where.
I've noted which way it dodges.

lines.zh: 这只猎物会跑，得先封路。
lines.en: This prey runs; I must cut its path first.

lines.zh: 我把网挪到它必经的地方。
lines.en: I move my web to where it must pass.
The distance is right; I can begin.
Every eye is fixed on it.

lines.zh: 它还不知道自己被盯上了。
lines.en: It doesn't know it's been marked.

lines.zh: 我伏在枯枝上，等它走近。
lines.en: I lie on the dead branch, waiting.
The shard is already nocked.
When it turns, I shrink back.

lines.zh: 呼吸放慢，骨头也静下来。
lines.en: I slow my breath; even my bones go quiet.

lines.zh: 我算着它下一步落在哪。
lines.en: I calculate where its next step lands.
The wind pushes my silk aside.

lines.zh: 它靠上树干，我把骨片抬高。
lines.en: It leans on the trunk; I raise my shard.
Three more breaths, then I loose.

lines.zh: 我换了个角度，好打脖子。
lines.en: I shift angle for a clear shot at its neck.

lines.zh: 它回头看了两次，起疑了。
lines.en: It looked back twice; it's suspicious now.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，让骨色融进雾。
lines.en: I press low so my bone blends into fog.

lines.zh: 它一迈步，我的八条腿就绷紧。
lines.en: It takes a step and all eight legs tense.
I pounce, front legs landing first.

lines.zh: 骨片在这么近的距离用不上。
lines.en: A shard is useless at this range.
I pin it down with my legs.
It thrashes; my frame rattles.

lines.zh: 我咬下去，牙齿是骨做的。
lines.en: I bite down with teeth of bone.

lines.zh: 它踢断我一条腿，我还能站。
lines.en: It breaks one of my legs; I still stand.
I drag it toward the web.

lines.zh: 近身的时候，我其实更稳。
lines.en: Up close I'm actually steadier.
Blood seeps into my joints; hard to wash out.
It goes limp, so I loosen my legs.

lines.zh: 我从雾里站起来，骨头接上骨头。
lines.en: I rise out of the fog, bone joining bone.
This biome is always in mourning.

lines.zh: 我落地时，落叶响了一声。
lines.en: When I land, the dead leaves crackle once.
Old silk still clings to me.

lines.zh: 二十四点生命，够用一阵。
lines.en: Twenty-four health, enough for a while.

lines.zh: 我先找棵树，织第一张网。
lines.en: First I find a tree and spin my first web.
Other spiders crawl in the fog.
My shards haven't hardened yet.
I test my legs; all eight answer.

lines.zh: 月亮照在我的骨头上，很白。
lines.en: Moonlight on my bones is very white.

lines.zh: 火烧到骨头，味道像烤肉。
lines.en: Fire on bone smells like roasting meat.

lines.zh: 落地的时候，我听见自己裂了。
lines.en: Landing, I hear myself crack.
Water fills my joints and I grow heavy.
The blast slams me against a trunk.
An arrow threads the gap in my ribs.

lines.zh: 紫光缠住我的腿，动不了。
lines.en: Violet light binds my legs; I can't move.
Hungry enough that my shards soften.
The lightning turns me translucent white.

lines.zh: 骨头在往下掉，一片一片。
lines.en: My bones fall away, piece by piece.
